title: 日本ダービーにむけて

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: The Japanese Derby has arrived. After receiving encouragement from her mother, Eishin Flash makes for the racetrack with her usual mindset…

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: But the crowd's impassioned cheering wakes an overwhelming desire in her to win, causing her to become anxious.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: As the determination to become Derby champion fills her being, she takes on the once-in-a-lifetime race with great resolve.
